text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P1 page - INC-2026-042 - serving errors for /v1/generate detected at 2026-03-14T16:10:00Z. Error rate spike > 5% for 2m. Affected model: redwood/gptx-13b. Potential customer impact: elevated latency and 500s for some tenants (notably AcmeCorp).
maya: picking this up as primary. seeing a lot of 5xx from model-router frontend. digging into logs now :eyes:
rob: i'm secondary, on call to assist. if you need a hand with infra checks ping me.
maya: quick checks done:
- kubectl get pods -n inference -> router-rc has 3/3, model-workers 12/12
- router logs show repeated downstream connection reset to model-worker-7
- kv-cache hit ratio is normal
maya: running a targeted curl test against router instances to reproduce
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://router.internal/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer redwood-test'; done
```
maya: reproduced ~30% 500s from router-2. tailing model-worker-7 logs now.
ethan: i can take night coverage overlap in ~30m; ETA to be fully in rotation 16:45Z.
maya: handoff plan: i'll remain until 16:40Z, then hand primary to rob. rob will be primary overnight; ethan will be secondary starting 16:45Z until 23:00Z when sylvia takes over for the night rota. noting we have a coverage gap 03:00-06:00Z — no volunteer yet.
rob: confirmed. for the handoff: key runbook snippets:
- runbook: /runbooks/serving/500-errors.md
- immediate mitigations: scale model-worker pool + restart router replica
- quick command for scaling:
```
kubectl scale deploy model-workers --replicas=16 -n inference
kubectl rollout restart deploy/router-rc -n inference
```
maya: i've already scaled model-workers to 16 and restarted router-2. initial error rate dropped to ~2.1% but still above baseline. looks like hotspot on model-worker-7, investigating OOMs.
rob: check pod memory and coredumps
```
kubectl describe pod model-worker-7 -n inference
kubectl logs model-worker-7 -n inference --since=10m
```
maya: model-worker-7 shows OOMKilled twice in last 15m, restart count 3. core pattern: memory spike during long-context requests. dumped logs to /tmp/INC-2026-042-model-worker-7.log
sylvia: tagging for customer impact: AcmeCorp reported 20% of their requests returned 500s between 16:05-16:25Z. need to notify CS and account. no data exfil, only availability.
rob: created ticket TICKET-8822 to track root cause (ooms + router retry storm). assigned to infra/serving. link: https://tracker.internal/TICKET-8822
maya: filing a separate ops task for alert tuning: alerts fired late due to aggregation window. will file as ACTION-983.
ethan: i'll own temporary runbook update so next oncall won't have to rediscover the scale + restart steps. updating /runbooks/serving/500-errors.md now.
maya: post-handoff checklist for rob (copying since i'm leaving in 10m):
- confirm altered autoscaler thresholds (we scaled manually)
- watch error rate for 30m, if >4% escalate to infra-pager
- coordinate with CS about customer-facing status update (sylvia will post)
- capture core dumps & attach to TICKET-8822
rob: acknowledged. i'll maintain a 10m check cadence until 18:00Z then move to 30m.
sylvia: i'll post a brief status note to #customer-status: "Investigating elevated serving errors for model redwood/gptx-13b; partial impact to select tenants including AcmeCorp. Mitigations in progress. No data exposure."
maya: final note before handoff — planned retro: Thurs 2026-03-19 16:00Z (RETRO-582). agenda: alert windows, autoscaler tuning, memory profiles for model-worker. i'll add the items and invite infra + product owners.
rob: will file a follow-up with precise remediation steps once we capture cores. creating ACTION-984 for increase memory request for model-worker images, assigning to @infra-build.
ethan: volunteer to cover the 03:00-06:00Z gap for this week if we can get an overtime approval. tagging @sylvia for approval.
sylvia: approve for this incident only, please add oncall overtime note. also scheduling a brief sync tomorrow 09:00Z to review TICKET-8822 findings.
maya: handing off now — rob primary, ethan secondary. logging out. :white_check_mark:
rob: taking over as primary. continuing monitoring. current error rate 1.8% and trending down. keeping this thread live for updates and retro notes.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status changed to "Mitigating" at 2026-03-14T16:40:00Z. Pages will remain until error rate < 1% for 15m.
rob: filing final post-handoff notes: created subtask TICKET-8822-1 (collect core dumps) and TICKET-8822-2 (increase kube mem requests). both linked to main ticket. will update CS and close once stable for 60m.
sylvia: thanks team. action items summary:
- ACTION-983 (maya) = alert aggregation window tuning
- ACTION-984 (rob) = resource requests + image review
- ACTION-985 (ethan) = runbook update + test playbook
- TICKET-8822 (assigned infra/serving) = root cause + fix
- RETRO-582 scheduled 2026-03-19 16:00Z
please keep notes in ticket and add any logs/commands used.
rob: endorsing. i'll ping here if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
